scenes.say: Introducing TableMate, your calm partner for the busiest nights.

sfx.text: soft warm restaurant ambience, distant murmur of diners, one gentle cutlery chime

scenes.say: Imagine a Saturday night. The restaurant is full, and service has to be just right. Six tables, six different types of needs, and one server is expected to remember it all.

sfx.text: busy restaurant kitchen clatter, pans and plates, quick and rhythmic, short

scenes.say: When service slips, the server often takes the blame, even when the delay was never theirs.

sfx.text: a single wine glass clink followed by a soft comedic oops slide-down tone

scenes.say: Meet TableMate, an AI copilot that turns the chaos into clarity. It gives every server their next three moves right when they need them.

sfx.text: three soft gentle notification chimes ascending, clean and friendly

scenes.say: An allergy flagged, TableMate gets the right information to the kitchen, fast, because some steps can never be missed.

sfx.text: soft alert ping then a reassuring success chime

scenes.say: And when delays happen, it follows the timeline. Was it the kitchen, the handoff, or the floor? Better evidence means better decisions.
Managers see where help is needed, not who to blame. No individual leaderboard, just a team working better together.

sfx.text: soft digital ding with a gentle shimmer

scenes.say: Difficult guest, tough conversation, servers can practise privately, learn from feedback, and build confidence before the next real shift,

sfx.text: two soft chat message pops, one sent one received

scenes.say: in their language, at their pace, with tools designed to support different needs, not another layer of stress.

sfx.text: warm friendly chime, bright and short

scenes.say: TableMate: quick, correct, and together. Better service for guests, better support for the people who make it happen.

sfx.text: gentle bell sparkle resolving on a warm major chord
